entries.heading: EXPANSION OF DEATH GRATUITY FOR ROTC GRADUATES
ancestors: Subtitle C—Disability Pay, Retired Pay, and Family and Survivor
entries.text:
SEC. 623. EXPANSION OF DEATH GRATUITY FOR ROTC GRADUATES.

    Section 623(b) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal 
Year 2020 (Public Law 116-92) is amended by 
striking ``the date of the enactment of this Act'' and inserting ``May 
1, 2017''.
